description: Re-reads the connected billing platform (Stripe portal, prices, Checkout Sessions; rate-limited), re-fetches the registered policies, pre-checks the checkout, re-evaluates every law and queues a scan. Use it for the first check after setup, after deploying several changes, after changing a Stripe setting, or when the plan looks stale. Waits up to `wait` seconds, then call get_compliance_plan.

site.description: Site id (site_…). Optional when the account has exactly one site in this mode; list_sites shows them.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the result before answering (0-30; larger values wait 30; default 25). Use 0 to return at once and poll later.

name: verify_site
title: Re-check the whole site now
